name: @repo/video-modal
description: A video thumbnail that morphs into a full accessible player inside a modal, with a custom keyboard-operable control bar.

useCases: Thumbnail grid that opens a full video player on click
Product demo or trailer with real controls and captions
compositionHints: Provide captions for anything that carries dialogue or narration
Set showCustomControls to false to fall back to native browser controls
Pass open / onOpenChange to drive the modal from a parent list
